decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line launched only in 2023 and given visible standalone presentation on the website, it remains a low-risk option whose market potential is not yet fully revealed.
This serum fits the firm’s established natural facial-care capabilities, and after only one year there is too little negative evidence to justify abandoning a relatively inexpensive option.

The cleansing milk is adjacent to the existing range and likely uses the firm’s current formulation and production base, so keeping it preserves upside while uncertainty is still high and sunk launch costs are already incurred.
